purpose: Transform explicit geometry and acoustic assumptions into traceable modal frequencies and deterministic audio renders, with optional later AI texture layers.
operator: GEOMETRY -> MODE_SOLVER -> EVIDENCE_GATE -> PHYSICAL_MODAL_BANK -> OPTIONAL_CREATIVE_TRANSLATION -> WAV_RENDER -> PROVENANCE_RECEIPT

core_equation.constraints: p,q,r are non-negative integers and cannot all be zero

development_path: v0.1 rectangular modal solver + deterministic WAV renderer
v0.3 measured impulse-response ingestion and convolution
v0.4 material-loss and source/listener position model
v0.5 Stable Audio / generative texture bridge with provenance
v1.0 validated converter pipeline with tests and schema versioning
